meta.title: Rooftop Courier
meta.instructions: Tap to jump, and tap again in the air to double-jump. Run the night rooftops: hop the vents, leap the alleys and grab the glowing letters to build a combo. The city speeds up the farther you go. Three stumbles ends the run.

over_gap.body: player.y >= 470.0 and any(gaps, g => player.x > g.x + 8.0 and player.x < g.x + g.w - 8.0)

colliders.body: concat(fold(blocks, [], (acc, b) => concat(acc, if b.tall then [vec(b.x, 473.0), vec(b.x, 443.0)] else [vec(b.x, 474.0)])), if over_gap() then [player] else [])

do.value: {id: seq + 1 + i, x: 360.0 + i * 30.0, y: if tall then 360.0 else 395.0}
{id: seq, x: player.x + 10.0, y: player.y - 40.0, born: now, text: '+' + str(10 + 5 * combo)}

then.value: {id: seq, x: 180.0, y: 250.0, born: now, text: str(meters) + ' m  +50'}

do.value: {id: seq, x: player.x + 20.0, y: player.y - 50.0, born: now, text: 'Whoa!'}

art.style: Night rooftops: violet-to-magenta dusk, a far skyline with warm windows, purple brick facades, a courier in a yellow jacket and teal cap, steel roof vents with red warning lights and hazard stripes, glowing cyan letters.
